subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard adopt a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed completion gate as the permanent review lifecycle for existing users?
rationale: The PR changes persisted card state and completion behavior in a way that can stop existing Workboard workflows at runtime, so maintainers need to confirm the product and upgrade direction before repair work can be considered sufficient.

options.title: Repair and keep the new lifecycle
options.body: Accept the durable review lifecycle, but require the gate, response envelope, metadata declarations, status consumers, tests, and real proof to be fixed before merge.

options.title: Use existing statuses
options.body: Rework the review flow around existing `review` and `done` states if maintainers do not want another persisted Workboard status.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Hold or close this branch if the review-gate product direction is not ready for core Workboard yet.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep the new lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept the durable review lifecycle, but require the gate, response envelope, metadata declarations, status consumers, tests, and real proof to be fixed before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the Workboard lifecycle and status-contract surfaces this PR changes.
